## Sri Lanka Dengue Situation in 2026 (up to October 2026)


## Sri Lanka Dengue Situation in 2025

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| out-width: 100%
#| out-height: 1500px

# ============================================================
# LIBRARIES
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(fuzzyjoin)
library(denguedatahub)
library(ceylon)
library(stringdist)
library(viridis)
library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(jsonlite)
library(leafsync)


# ============================================================
# PART 1: DISTRICT DATA
# ============================================================

data(srilanka_weekly_data)
data(district)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Aggregate annual dengue cases
# ------------------------------------------------------------

annual_df <- srilanka_weekly_data %>%
  group_by(year, district) %>%
  summarise(
    annual_cases = sum(cases, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(year == 2025)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Clean district names
# ------------------------------------------------------------

annual_df <- annual_df %>%
  mutate(
    district_clean = toupper(trimws(district))
  )

district_sf <- district %>%
  mutate(
    DISTRICT_clean = toupper(trimws(DISTRICT))
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Fuzzy match district names
# ------------------------------------------------------------

annual_df <- annual_df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    DISTRICT_match = district_sf$DISTRICT_clean[
      amatch(
        district_clean,
        district_sf$DISTRICT_clean,
        maxDist = 3
      )
    ]
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Join annual cases with polygons
# ------------------------------------------------------------

annual_sf <- district_sf %>%
  left_join(
    annual_df,
    by = c(
      "DISTRICT_clean" = "DISTRICT_match"
    )
  ) %>%
  st_transform(4326)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# District data used for map
# ------------------------------------------------------------

district_sf <- annual_sf %>%
  filter(!is.na(annual_cases)) %>%
  mutate(

    # IMPORTANT:
    # This is the common key used to connect
    # Map 1 and Map 2.

    district_key = toupper(
      trimws(DISTRICT)
    )

  )


# ============================================================
# DISTRICT MAP
# ============================================================

district_pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = "YlOrRd",
  domain = district_sf$annual_cases,
  na.color = "white"
)


map1 <- leaflet(
  district_sf
) %>%

  addTiles() %>%

  addPolygons(

    # District key used by JavaScript
    layerId = ~district_key,

    fillColor = ~district_pal(
      annual_cases
    ),

    fillOpacity = 0.75,

    color = "white",

    weight = 1,

    popup = ~paste0(

      "<b>District:</b> ",
      DISTRICT,

      "<br><b>Annual cases:</b> ",
      format(
        annual_cases,
        big.mark = ","
      )

    ),

    label = ~paste0(

      DISTRICT,
      ": ",
      format(
        annual_cases,
        big.mark = ","
      ),
      " cases"

    )

  ) %>%

  addLegend(

    position = "bottomright",

    pal = district_pal,

    values = ~annual_cases,

    title = "Dengue cases<br>(2025)",

    opacity = 1

  ) %>%

  setView(

    lng = 80.7,

    lat = 7.8,

    zoom = 10

  )


# ============================================================
# PART 2: MOH AREA DATA
# ============================================================


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Read Dengue Atlas data
# ------------------------------------------------------------


#DengueAtlas1 <- read_excel("dataraw/DengueAtlas.xlsx", sheet=1)
DengueAtlas1 <- read_csv("dataraw/2026_11_1.csv")
DengueAtlas2 <- read_excel("dataraw/DengueAtlas.xlsx", sheet=2)
df <- read_csv("dataraw/sri_lanka_areas_coordinates.csv")



df <- df %>%
  rename(
    HighRiskMOHAreas = area
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Join coordinates with Dengue Atlas
# ------------------------------------------------------------

merged_df <- DengueAtlas1 %>%

  left_join(
    df,
    by = "HighRiskMOHAreas"
  )


# ============================================================
# AGGREGATE MOH DATA FOR 2025
# ============================================================

moh_df <- merged_df %>%

  filter(

    Year == 2025,

    !is.na(longitude),

    !is.na(latitude),

    is.finite(longitude),

    is.finite(latitude),

    !is.na(Cases)

  ) %>%

  mutate(

    Cases = as.numeric(Cases),

    # IMPORTANT:
    # Make the district key exactly the same
    # format as the district map.

    district_key = toupper(
      trimws(District)
    )

  ) %>%

  group_by(

    HighRiskMOHAreas,

    District,

    district_key,

    longitude,

    latitude

  ) %>%

  summarise(

    Cases = sum(
      Cases,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"

  ) %>%

  mutate(

    longitude = as.numeric(longitude),

    latitude = as.numeric(latitude)

  )


# ============================================================
# CHECK THE CONNECTION
# ============================================================

# This should return character(0).
#
# If it does not, those are district names that
# do not have a matching district polygon.

unmatched_districts <- setdiff(

  unique(
    moh_df$district_key
  ),

  unique(
    district_sf$district_key
  )

)

print(unmatched_districts)


# ============================================================
# MOH MAP
# ============================================================

moh_pal <- colorNumeric(

 # palette = "RdPu",
  
  palette = "YlGnBu",

  domain = moh_df$Cases,

  na.color = "grey"

)


map2 <- leaflet(
  moh_df
) %>%

  addTiles() %>%

  addCircleMarkers(

    # MOH area identifier
    layerId = ~HighRiskMOHAreas,

    lng = ~longitude,

    lat = ~latitude,

    radius = ~pmax(
     5,
     sqrt(Cases) * 1.2
    ),

    color = "white",

    weight = 1.5,

    fillColor = ~moh_pal(
      Cases
    ),

    fillOpacity = 0.85,

    popup = ~paste0(

      "<b>MOH area:</b> ",
      HighRiskMOHAreas,

      "<br><b>District:</b> ",
      District,

      "<br><b>Year:</b> 2025",

      "<br><b>Total cases:</b> ",
      format(
        Cases,
        big.mark = ","
      )

    ),

    label = ~paste0(

      HighRiskMOHAreas,

      ": ",

      format(
        Cases,
        big.mark = ","
      ),

      " cases"

    )

  ) %>%

  addLegend(

    position = "bottomright",

    pal = moh_pal,

    values = ~Cases,

    title = "MOH-area cases<br>(2025)",

    opacity = 1

  )


# ============================================================
# PART 3: CONNECT THE MAPS
# ============================================================


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Convert MOH district information to JavaScript
# ------------------------------------------------------------

moh_district_keys <- jsonlite::toJSON(

  moh_df$district_key,

  auto_unbox = TRUE

)


# ============================================================
# MAP 1 -> MAP 2
# ============================================================

map1 <- htmlwidgets::onRender(

  map1,

  "
  function(el, x) {

    var map = this;

    // Make Map 1 globally accessible
    window.districtMap = map;


    // Go through all district polygons

    map.eachLayer(function(layer) {

      if (
        layer.options &&
        layer.options.layerId
      ) {


        // Save original style

        layer.options.originalFillColor =
          layer.options.fillColor;


        // ------------------------------------------
        // When a district is clicked
        // ------------------------------------------

        layer.on('click', function(e) {

          var selectedDistrict =
            layer.options.layerId;


          // ----------------------------------------
          // Highlight selected district
          // ----------------------------------------

          map.eachLayer(function(otherLayer) {

            if (
              otherLayer.options &&
              otherLayer.options.layerId
            ) {

              if (
                otherLayer.options.layerId ===
                selectedDistrict
              ) {

                otherLayer.setStyle({

                  color: 'blue',

                  weight: 4,

                  fillOpacity: 0.9

                });

              }

              else {

                otherLayer.setStyle({

                  color: 'white',

                  weight: 1,

                  fillOpacity: 0.75

                });

              }

            }

          });


          // ----------------------------------------
          // Highlight corresponding MOH areas
          // ----------------------------------------

          if (window.mohMap) {

            window.mohMap.eachLayer(
              function(mohLayer) {

                if (
                  !mohLayer.options ||
                  !mohLayer.options.districtKey
                ) {

                  return;

                }


                if (
                  mohLayer.options.districtKey ===
                  selectedDistrict
                ) {

                  // Matching MOH area

                  mohLayer.setStyle({

                    color: 'blue',

                    weight: 3,

                    fillColor: 'yellow',

                    fillOpacity: 1

                  });

                }

                else {

                  // Non-matching MOH area

                  mohLayer.setStyle({

                    color: 'white',

                    weight: 1,

                    fillColor:
                      mohLayer.options.originalFillColor,

                    fillOpacity: 0.85

                  });

                }

              }
            );

          }

        });

      }

    });

  }
  "

)


# ============================================================
# MAP 2 -> MAP 1
# ============================================================

map2 <- htmlwidgets::onRender(

  map2,

  sprintf(

  "
  function(el, x) {

    var map = this;


    // Make Map 2 globally accessible

    window.mohMap = map;


    // District associated with each marker

    var districts = %s;


    // Index used to associate each marker
    // with its district

    var markerIndex = 0;


    // Go through every layer

    map.eachLayer(function(layer) {


      // Only process CircleMarkers

      if (
        layer instanceof L.CircleMarker
      ) {


        // ---------------------------------------
        // Store district key
        // ---------------------------------------

        layer.options.districtKey =
          districts[markerIndex];


        // ---------------------------------------
        // Store original colour
        // ---------------------------------------

        layer.options.originalFillColor =
          layer.options.fillColor;


        markerIndex++;


        // ---------------------------------------
        // When an MOH area is clicked
        // ---------------------------------------

        layer.on('click', function(e) {

          var selectedDistrict =
            layer.options.districtKey;


          // -------------------------------------
          // Highlight MOH areas in same district
          // -------------------------------------

          map.eachLayer(
            function(otherMOHLayer) {

              if (
                otherMOHLayer instanceof
                L.CircleMarker
              ) {


                if (
                  otherMOHLayer.options.districtKey ===
                  selectedDistrict
                ) {

                  otherMOHLayer.setStyle({

                    color: 'blue',

                    weight: 3,

                    fillColor: 'yellow',

                    fillOpacity: 1

                  });

                }

                else {

                  otherMOHLayer.setStyle({

                    color: 'white',

                    weight: 1,

                    fillColor:
                      otherMOHLayer.options.originalFillColor,

                    fillOpacity: 0.85

                  });

                }

              }

            }
          );


          // -------------------------------------
          // Highlight district on Map 1
          // -------------------------------------

          if (window.districtMap) {

            window.districtMap.eachLayer(
              function(districtLayer) {

                if (
                  districtLayer.options &&
                  districtLayer.options.layerId
                ) {


                  if (
                    districtLayer.options.layerId ===
                    selectedDistrict
                  ) {


                    // Highlight district

                    districtLayer.setStyle({

                      color: 'blue',

                      weight: 4,

                      fillColor: 'yellow',

                      fillOpacity: 0.9

                    });


                    // Zoom to district

                    window.districtMap.fitBounds(

                      districtLayer.getBounds()

                    );


                    // Open district popup

                    districtLayer.openPopup();


                  }

                  else {

                    // Restore other districts

                    districtLayer.setStyle({

                      color: 'white',

                      weight: 1,

                      fillOpacity: 0.75

                    });

                  }

                }

              }
            );

          }

        });

      }

    });

  }
  ",

  moh_district_keys

  )

)


# ============================================================
# PART 4: DISPLAY SIDE-BY-SIDE
# ============================================================

htmltools::tagList(
  htmltools::tags$div(
    style = "display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px;",
    htmltools::tags$div(
      htmltools::tags$h4("(a)"),
      map1
    ),
    htmltools::tags$div(
      htmltools::tags$h4("(b)"),
      map2
    )
  )
)

#leafsync::sync(

#  map1,

#  map2,

#  ncol = 2

#)


```

Note: For MOH area data  week 5, week 11, week 18, weeks 26 to week 52 reports were missing. Hence, those week counts were not included in the map.
